tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant | Java, Spring & Integration Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven techno-functional consultant: gathering requirements, designing data flows, writing user stories, and supporting production. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, Agile teams and AI-assisted development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP S/4HANA, CRM & Customer Management Consultant
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Prachi Baviskar’s vision to drive SAP CX solutions across Germany. With over five years of hands-on experience building and integrating SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in SAP-centric e-commerce, API design and techno-functional consulting that aligns with your consultancy focus.

bullets.label: Integration Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring seamless product data flow across ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services for headless commerce at both Rockwell and Shell, delivering robust APIs for storefronts and third-party integrations.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to gather requirements, write user stories and functional specs, translating them into SAP Commerce solutions that improved order management and catalog accuracy.

bullets.label: Production & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), managed Docker/Kubernetes environments and resolved production incidents, ensuring high availability for global e-commerce sites.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: Prachi Baviskar’s focus on SAP CX and end-to-end customer management aligns perfectly with my experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions that integrate product, ERP and MDM data. I am eager to apply my techno-functional consulting skills to help your clients accelerate digital transformation and achieve measurable business value across Germany’s competitive market.
tailoring.motivation_short: Passionate about leveraging my SAP Commerce expertise to drive SAP CX initiatives and deliver integrated, customer-centric solutions for Prachi Baviskar’s clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud consultant with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about the SAP S/4HANA, CRM & Customer Management Consultant role at Prachi Baviskar and would love to discuss how my integration and techno-functional experience can add value.

tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP S/4HANA, CRM & Customer Management Consultant role. With 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I offer strong SAP integration, API development and techno-functional consulting experience. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss my fit.
